description:
3600W Dual Motor Dominance – Conquer Any Terrain
Dual 1800W high-speed motors unleash a staggering 3600W peak output, providing explosive acceleration and the raw power to tackle 26° (≈48%) inclines without breaking a sweat. Whether it’s steep urban hills or rugged mountain trails, the H11 is built to dominate.
100 km Ultra-Long Range & Mobile Power Hub
Equipped with a massive 52V 23.4Ah (1216.8Wh) high-capacity battery, the H11 delivers an extraordinary range of up to 100 km. Stay powered up in the wild with integrated USB and Type-C charging ports, ensuring your smartphone or GPS stays charged while you explore the great outdoors.
Revolutionary Swingarm Suspension & 10" All-Terrain Tires
Experience ultimate stability with our advanced front and rear swingarm suspension system, designed to soak up massive impacts far better than standard forks. Paired with 10x3-inch puncture-resistant tubeless vacuum tires, you get superior grip and comfort on gravel, dirt, or asphalt.
Smart Tech & Rugged Safety Features
Secure your ride with NFC unlocking and Bluetooth App connectivity for a fully digital experience. Stay visible and safe in any environment with a bright lighting system, including handlebar-end turn signals and an IP54 waterproof rating, ensuring the H11 is as reliable as it is powerful.
